raw_result.summary: The corrected authorization seam is feasible with current Web Identity, ManagementAccess and Data Protection ownership. It rejects caller-substituted subjects and targets, checks authorization before migration/setup and at protected use, and covers standalone Repositories without changing ordinary source policy. The architecture classification, valid design IDs, database isolation and unresolved 18.1 dependency remain intact. Independent review remains pending.
raw_result.authorization_boundary: Web derives the principal from existing Identity and issues a short-lived purpose-bound activation grant; the generator validates it through Web. Deployment-owned allowlists map opaque target IDs to canonical database descriptors, both hosts check connected identity before migration, standalone Repository requires current ManagementAccess and SystemId null, and protected use rechecks live authority.
raw_result.story_18_1_separation: The activation grant authorizes setup/selection only and does not authorize source reads or replace Story 18.1 grants.
